kangaroo-ca-2017-g0910-02.prompt: My new printer prints 24 pages in 1.5 minutes. How many pages does it print in 5 minutes?

kangaroo-ca-2017-g0910-06.prompt: Some girls were dancing in a circle. Antonia was the fifth to the left of Bianca and the eighth to the right of Bianca. How many girls were in the group?

kangaroo-ca-2017-g0910-12.prompt: How many pairs $(a, b)$ of digits $a$ and $b$ satisfy the condition that the product $\overline{30a} \cdot \overline{7b8}$ of the three-digit numbers $\overline{30a}$ and $\overline{7b8}$ is positive and divisible by 15?

kangaroo-ca-2017-g0910-18.prompt: Pere would like to determine who earns more money and who earns less among his three colleagues, Francis, Maria and Joana, from the following two facts. First, he knows that if Francis is not the best paid among the three of them, it must be Joana. Second, he knows that if Joana is not the worst paid, then Maria is the one who earns the most. Who is the one who earns the most, and the one who earns the least, in this order?

kangaroo-ca-2017-g0910-26.prompt: A sequence of 2017 digits is written. It is known that all two-digit numbers, which consist of two consecutive digits in the sequence (in the order in which they are written) are divisible by 17 or by 23. The last digit in the sequence is 1. What is the first digit in the sequence?

kangaroo-ca-2017-g0910-27.prompt: When you swap the digits of a two-digit code, you get the mirrored code: e.g. 80 becomes 08 and the other way around. Look at all the possible codes from 00 up to 99. How many of them differ by a perfect square from their mirrored code? (Note 0 is a perfect square as well!)

kangaroo-ca-2017-g0910-30.prompt: Point $D$ is chosen on the side $AC$ of triangle $ABC$ so that $DC = AB$. Points $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of the segments $AD$ and $BC$, respectively. If $\angle NMC = \alpha$, what is the measure of $\angle BAC$?
